Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Friday that Beijing has “influence” over Moscow it should use to stop the war in Ukraine, and that a proposed summit meeting of the US, Chinese and Russian leaders must not lead to the division of his war-torn country.

news.headline: Trump says US may launch ‘another little Epic Fury’ attack on Iran
news.summary: US President Donald Trump on Friday said his country may launch “another little Epic Fury” on Iran, referring to the joint Israeli-American military operation that sparked the war with Iran at the end of February.

news.headline: FCC Democrat warns broadcasters to resist Trump’s media pressure tactics
news.summary: Democrat Anna Gomez warns broadcasters against yielding to the Trump-era FCC's claims of fake polls and news distortions.

news.headline: Time ‘running out’ to reach Yemen’s Taiz amid deepening crisis, UN says
news.summary: More than 800,000 people have been cut off from aid since the Houthis encircled Taiz city in early October.
